messages:
marta: quick heads-up — spotted a drift in KSA token TTLs for gpu-pool-* svcaccounts, expected 24h but tokens minted with 2h expiry this morning :thinking_face:
kevin: wait what. where are you seeing that? audit logs?
marta: in the cluster audit we ingest to cloud-logs — token.create events show expiry=7200s, not 86400s. assoc'd secret names look like gpu-pool-proxy-token-xxxxx
alex: hmm did we roll a k8s apiserver flag change? or is this a controller that mints projected tokens?
marta: it's coming from the node-sa-token-controller we deployed last week (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1287). controller config has DEFAULT_TTL=2h, intended for short-lived operators but it got applied to gpu namespace via label selector mistake
kevin: oof. that's the label-scope bug we discussed. can we hotfix to scope to operators only?
alex: yes — quick mitigation is to add an override annotation on gpu svcaccounts: kubectl annotate sa gpu-pool -n infra redwood.io/token-ttl=86400 --overwrite
marta: I did that for the pool-proxy instances, but some ephemeral jobs already got 2h tokens and they hopped to different nodes causing retries
sre-oncall: infra-bot just created incident INC-2024-045 and linked logging+audit for the window 2024-04-25T08:00..10:30Z :rotating_light:
infra-bot: Incident INC-2024-045 created by marta — severity: P2 — shortdesc: gpu svcaccount token-ttl misconfig -> intermittent pod restarts — runbook: https://confluence.redwood/inci/INC-2024-045
kevin: next steps? I'd like a permanent fix in the controller + an admission check to block token-ttl overrides outside allowed namespaces
alex: I'll open a PR with two commits: 1) tighten selector in node-sa-token-controller, 2) add validating webhook that rejects token TTL < 4h for any svcaccount in infra/gpu namespaces unless exempted. link when ready
marta: also need to check KMS envelope access for the revoked tokens — some tokens were used to fetch keys via kms-encrypt API but KMS logs show deny for the same token after 2h. suspicious timing for potential data-misuse, filing a vuln triage ticket
kevin: add SIEM search for "token.create" + "gpu-pool" and correlate with kms.access logs for the two-hour window. if we see anomalous key access escalate to SRE + CISO
infra-bot: correlating logs now — playback will take ~3m, will post summary
alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1299 — includes unit tests for selector + webhook. tagging @kevin for review
kevin: reviewing now. if green we'll ship canary to staging then prod-migrate after 30m observation
marta: also adding an audit pipeline alert — if average token TTL for a namespace deviates >10% from expected trigger pagerduty
sre-oncall: copied — will run a retrospective once incident wraps. nice catch, Marta :thumbsup:
kevin: one more note: rotate any long-lived deploy keys that were combined with ephemeral tokens as a precaution
alex: agreed. I'll draft the rotation plan and post timeline in the incident doc
marta: thanks team. I'll update the incident with the KMS correlation results and mark follow-ups for least-privilege gating + webhook enforcement
infra-bot: Incident INC-2024-045 updated: mitigation applied (annotation override), controller patch merged to main, canary deploy queued.
